prerequisites: General requirements for access to the degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
To know and apply basic elements of economics and human resource management, project organization and planning, as well as legislation, regulation and standardization in telecommunications.
Adequate knowledge of the business concept, institutional and legal framework of the company. Organization and management of companies.
Understand the concept of business, types of businesses, and the environment in which it operates.
Be able to understand the different subsystems that integrate the company.
Understand the principles of business organization and management.

syllabus_topics: Functioning of economic activity and types of markets
Concept and objectives of the company
Types of companies: economic, organizational and legal criteria
Asset and results analysis for decision making
Valuation of investment and financing projects
teaching_methods: Presentation of individual or group works
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as: FINAL GRADE = EX.ORD + P1 + P2 + P3 + P. To pass, a minimum of 40% (2.6 points) is required in the final exam (EX.ORD), and a minimum of 1.4 points in the sum of P1, P2, P3, and P (40% of their total 3.5 points). If all minimums are met and the final grade is at least 5 points, the course is passed. If all minimums are met but the final grade is less than 5 points, the course is failed with the calculated grade. If the final grade exceeds 5 points but a minimum is not met, the final grade will be 4.5 (fail). For extraordinary exams, students can retake the theoretical-practical exam (EX.EXTR) and/or a practical exam (EX.PR), keeping previously passed components; the same minimums apply.
